title: Give Me Convenience and Give Her Death: Who Should Decide What Uses of NLP are Appropriate, and on What Basis?
reasoning: The core objective of the paper is an ethical analysis of NLP research practices. It evaluates the ethical dimensions of a specific case study, discusses 'data ethics', 'dual use', and calls for the community to develop better mechanisms for ethical self-assessment. It is not just an 'ethical considerations' section but the primary subject matter.
